name: Chess Set
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

Crafted from premium-quality wood with a sturdy 5mm thickness, ensuring durability and a natural, classic aesthetic.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

The chess set comes in two size options:

 - 8x8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm

 - 10x10 inches ~ 25.24 x 25.24 cm

  • Storage Box Sizes (assemble dimensions):

 - For 8x8 inches option (LxWxH): 5.12 x 3.94 x 1.93 inches ~ 13 x 10 x 4.89 cm

 - For 10x10 inches option (LxWxH): 6.3 x 4.89 x 2.36 inches ~ 16 x12.4 x 6 cm

 

  •  Canvas Drawstring Bag:

Each chess set comes with a canvas drawstring pouch, perfect for storing all the wooden chess pieces securely. The durable and breathable canvas fabric ensures long-lasting use and makes it easy to carry the game on-the-go. Whether you're playing at home, traveling, or storing it away, this handy bag keeps everything neat and organized.

 

  • Printing Technology:

Printed using UV printing technology for high-resolution, sharp, and vibrant images. The product features double-sided printing, making it visually appealing from all angles.

 

  • Functionality & Usage:

A compact, foldable wooden chess set that doubles as a storage box. It is ideal for playing chess on the go or at home and helps keep all pieces neatly organized.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasions:

This elegant wooden chess set is a thoughtful and versatile gift, perfect for children, adults, friends, and family on any occasion — be it Christmas, birthdays, Father’s Day, or any special celebration.

 

SPECIFICATION

 

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Chess Set, 1xCanvas Drawstring Bag, 1xStorage Box ( requires self-assembly)

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
